about: The Harmony 350's test setup, todo-compile-350.md 3.1: the shared test setup's seven devices plus the Knoll HDP-1100, the eighth device the Harmony 650 ran, so every device key holds a short and a long press device; its one activity is the shared setup's TV kijken; and five favourite channels on the KPN, the last with a leading zero. Which device goes on which key is not part of this file's format, and Logitech's service chose it: in its compile the device keys short and long are top left LG TV and Knoll, top right Plasma and Kodi, bottom left Denon and Switch, bottom right KPN and Sony HT. This said TV LG TV and Plasma, Cable KPN and Kodi, DVD Denon and Sony HT, Aux Switch and Knoll, which was the plan and not what the service did.
